issues.description: 37 E030 findings: schema-qualified names (public.tenant, public.tenant_schemas, public.schema_migrations) appear in design prose. The E030 rule is intended for migration DDL bodies and the design uses these names as documentation references to existing tables and to the migration DDL sketch. Not blocking, but the design could be tightened by replacing 'public.tenant' with 'the tenant registry' and 'public.tenant_schemas' with 'the per-tenant schema registry' in the narrative text. Leaving to BACKEND-DEV or DOC-UPDATER discretion — not worth a rework cycle.
